justification.dataset: DANDI 000582 (Sargolini MEC) is the canonical grid-cell dataset with layer-annotated tetrode units and 2D tracking, emphasizing superficial layers.
justification.handling: Real data streamed via remfile, the meters-vs-centimeters metadata error is correctly caught and corrected, NaN tracking frames dropped, and a 200-spike inclusion criterion applied.
justification.analysis: Standard opexebo rate-map/autocorrelogram/grid-score pipeline with the required circular time-shift shuffle null distribution, correctly implemented.
justification.correctness: All headline numbers (620/617/197 units, per-layer prevalence, 58 cm median spacing IQR 46-71) reproduce exactly from the committed pkl and are physically plausible and internally consistent.
justification.figures: Figures show clear hexagonal firing lattices in spikes, rate maps, and autocorrelograms across six rats, with labeled axes, units, sample sizes, and a clean shuffle-null separation.
justification.honesty: Nothing is overstated and example units are honestly labeled as best/top for a demonstration, but no specific limitation of the result is named, capping this at 3 for a clean result.
